text:
maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — quick live Q&A follow-up from today's all-hands re: remote/hybrid + travel. I'll drop short answers and link resources as we go.

jordan (Eng): If I book a satellite office week, what's the cap on reimbursable travel?

maya (People Ops): Short answer: domestic flights up to $500, international up to $1,200 unless pre-approved. Per-diem follows finance table (see link). We'll open an exceptions queue for special cases. :+1:

ana? (typo)

ana (Finance): FYI the per-diem grid is here: https://handbook.redwood.com/ops/travel-per-diem — covers meals + local transit, receipts required for hotel/flight only.

jordan (Eng): Cool. For family travel (partner/kids) joining for an offsite, do we cover?

carlos (People Ops): Family travel isn't covered by default. We can support family add-ons on a case-by-case basis (esp. for caregiver accommodations). Please submit the travel-exception form and tag me/rebecca. We'll prioritise equity cases.

rebecca (People Ops): Adding: if you need childcare reimbursement while at an offsite (e.g., overnight), send receipts, we'll process up to $150/day with manager sign-off.

sasha (Eng-Infra): Quick logistics Q: how do we reserve a desk at the SF satellite? I saw something about hot-desk windows.

maya (People Ops): Reservation flow: calendar -> choose site -> book slot. If it's a "flex desk" week, you must book by Wednesday prior. Steps: 1) Visit https://internal.redwood.com/office-booking 2) Select site 3) Choose "satellite" option 4) Add your estimated days in notes. We'll auto-assign lockers to multi-day bookings.

sasha (Eng-Infra): Is there a charge for day passes for non-employees (contractors/vendors)?

carlos (People Ops): Contractors get 3 free day-passes / month, then $25/day. Vendors must have vendor onboarding + insurance docs; route those to security.

jordan (Eng): What about visas for international offsites? I plan a week in Berlin.

maya (People Ops): For company-sponsored international travel, People Ops will coordinate a visa letter if needed. Start at least 8 weeks out. Attach passport scan + dates to the travel request. We also cover expedited fees with approval.

ana? (typo again)

ana (Finance): We need cost codes on the travel form — default is "ops:satellite:travel" for decentralised bookings; teams can change to project-specific codes for chargeback.

jordan (Eng): Re: hybrid attendance — if I come into office one day/week, does that effect headcount seating?

rebecca (People Ops): No change to your headcount. Desk assignments are flexible. If your team needs recurring space, file a team-space request (we'll evaluate).

sasha (Eng-Infra): Any rules on equipment transport (GPUs, racks) between offices?

carlos (People Ops): Hardware movement requires pre-approval and a signed transport form for insurance. Small peripherals are fine; anything >$2k needs IT & legal sign-off.

jordan (Eng): For offsite planning, is there a recommended template for agendas and inclusivity guidelines?

maya (People Ops): Yes — agenda + inclusivity checklist + accessibility notes are on the offsite kit: https://handbook.redwood.com/offsites/kit. Please use the template; it speeds approvals.

offsite-bot: poll created — "Preferred offsite month" — Apr/May/Sep. (Results live in 24h)

ana? (typo fixed)

ana (Finance): Reminder: expense reports for travel must be submitted within 14 days of return or reimbursements can be delayed. Use Expensify and tag receipts with the event name.

jordan (Eng): One last: are there guidelines for remote work stipends and home office equipment if I alternate offices?

rebecca (People Ops): Stipend rules unchanged: $600/year home office or one-time up to $1,200 for ergonomic setup with manager approval. If you get permanent desk at a satellite, submit a one-time desk-setup request.

sasha (Eng-Infra): Thanks, very helpful. Will coordinate with the team on travel windows.

maya (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll consolidate these notes into a short follow-up doc and post to #people-ops pinned resources. Tag us if you need an exception. :sparkles:
